title: 第5章  差点散架了第6章  办公室play
slug: 恶女超会撩深陷兽夫雄竞修罗场
content_zh:
她手刚碰上领带，就被他的大手握住，按在了、床上，十指紧扣。
季欢轻呼一声，感觉到他来真的了。
她阖下眸子，也不去管眼睛上的领带了，就这样，去感受着他的存在。
他力、气大，花样也多。
这一夜……
季欢一直在哭，他偶尔会怜惜一下。
但他急的时候，也不管不顾的。
第二天，季欢醒来。
全身都快散架了，由于眼睛被蒙着，昨晚她算是见识到了什么叫感受？
所有感觉放到最大化，这种检验，简直要命，此生难忘。
季欢抬起酸软的手，扯掉了眼睛上的领带，印入眼帘的却是一张陌生的男人的脸。
这个男人比谢烬沉英俊百倍不止，而且他眉宇间的那种英气非常足。
季欢看过小说，但跟原主有关的剧情只到昨晚，她改变了剧情活了下来。
但这个人是谁？
季欢正疑惑的时候，她看到男人快要转醒了。
她睡错人了，那么就是任务失败。
啊？
她抬手摸了一下脸，嘴边长满了胡子。
她差点尖叫出声，于是只能轻手轻脚的下床，跑进了浴室。
季欢看着镜子里那个长发女人，白皙的嘴边长满了胡子。

她心蓦的一紧，这也太丑，太吓人了。
她这副样子出去，肯定要被人当成怪物的。
于是她开始呼唤系统。
“系统系统，快出来，救命呀！”
【主人，你任务失败，受惩罚中！】
“我要怎么做才能恢复原样？”
系统：【继续攻略谢烬沉，与他上床之后算是完成任务，就能恢复原样。】
季欢翻了个白眼，她现在这副鬼样子，谢烬沉会跟她上床才怪了？
系统：【主人加油！难度虽然很大，但我相信你聪明的大脑会想出完美的办法，再见！】
季欢骂了一句，“狗系统，一点用都没有。”
季欢赶紧拿出手机，开始查刚刚床上的那个男人到底是谁。
她从谢烬沉家族里的人查起，才点进去就看到了谢京墨的信息。
content_en:
As soon as her hand touched the tie, she was held by his big hand and pressed on the bed, their fingers clasped tightly.
Ji Huan shouted softly, feeling that he was serious.
She closed her eyes and ignored the tie on her eyes, just feeling his presence.
He has great strength and energy and many tricks.
This night...
Ji Huan kept crying, and he would occasionally take pity on her.
But when he was in a hurry, he didn't care.
The next day, Ji Huan woke up.
Her whole body was about to fall apart, and because her eyes were covered, she had seen what it meant to feel last night?
Putting all the feelings to the maximum, this kind of test is simply fatal and will be unforgettable in this lifetime.
Ji Huan raised his sore hands and pulled off the tie from his eyes. What he saw was the face of a strange man.
This man is more than a hundred times more handsome than Xie Jinchen, and the heroic spirit between his brows is very strong.
Ji Huan had read the novel, but the plot related to the original owner only lasted until last night. She changed the plot and survived.
But who is this person?
When Ji Huan was confused, she saw that the man was about to wake up.
If she slept with the wrong person, the mission would be a failure.
ah?
She raised her hand and touched her face. There was a beard growing around her mouth.
She almost screamed, so she could only get out of bed quietly and ran into the bathroom.
Ji Huan looked at the long-haired woman in the mirror, her fair mouth was covered with beard.
Her heart suddenly tightened, this was too ugly and scary.
If she goes out like this, she will definitely be regarded as a monster.
So she started calling the system.
"System, system, come out quickly, help!"
[Master, you failed the mission and are being punished! 】
“What can I do to get back to how I was?”
System: [Continue to conquer Xie Jinchen. After sleeping with him, the task will be completed and you will be able to return to your original state. 】
Ji Huan rolled his eyes. She looked like a ghost now. Is it weird that Xie Jinchen would sleep with her?
System: [Come on, Master! Although it is very difficult, I believe your smart brain will come up with a perfect solution. Goodbye! 】
Ji Huan cursed, "The dog system is useless at all."
Ji Huan quickly took out his cell phone and started to check who the man in bed just now was.
She started checking people in Xie Jinchen's family and saw Xie Jingmo's information when she clicked in.
